OpenRouter is a model aggregator that gives developers and AI power users one API and one chat interface for hundreds of models from dozens of providers. Instead of opening accounts with every lab, you top up credits once and call any model through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Its value is in routing: OpenRouter picks a working provider for each model, fails over when one is down, and lets you set rules about which providers may see your prompts.

## What is OpenRouter used for?

OpenRouter is used both as infrastructure for AI apps and as a convenient way for individuals to try new models the day they launch.

- Calling 600+ text, image, video and audio models through a single API key
- Switching between providers like Anthropic, OpenAI and Google by changing a model name
- Falling back to another provider automatically when one has an outage
- Chatting with any model, or several at once, in the web chat
- Restricting traffic to providers that meet your data policy, or to EU or US regions on Business
- Checking rankings to see which models and apps are most used

## Who OpenRouter is best for

OpenRouter suits developers building AI products who want flexibility across models, startups that do not want to manage many vendor contracts, and coding-agent users who plug it into tools like Cline. Researchers comparing models also find it handy. People who simply want a polished consumer chatbot with memory and voice are better served by a dedicated assistant app.

## OpenRouter pricing

OpenRouter has no subscription. The Free tier gives chat and API access to 25+ free models from four free providers, with a limit of 50 requests per day. Standard is pay as you go with a 5.5% platform fee on credit purchases and unlocks 600+ models, budgets, prompt caching, auto-routing and admin controls. Business is pay as you go with an 8% fee and adds EU and US in-region routing, workload identity federation and up to 1,000 workspaces. Enterprise adds SSO, contractual SLAs, invoicing and fee discounts by agreement. Model prices are listed per model on the site. All figures are from the pricing page as of October 2026.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- The platform fee makes each token slightly more expensive than buying directly from a provider
- Free models have tight daily request limits
- Behavior and latency can vary between providers serving the same model
- The chat interface is functional but lacks features like long-term memory

## OpenRouter vs alternatives

Together Chat is a better fit if you mainly want to chat with open models in the browser for free. OpenAI Playground and Google AI Studio are the direct choices when you only use one lab's models and want its newest features first. Poe is a consumer subscription app for many models without API work. Artificial Analysis is where to compare model speed and price before choosing. OpenRouter wins when you want one key, one bill and automatic failover across many providers.

## Tips for getting started with OpenRouter

Start with a small credit purchase and set a budget on your API key. Use the free models to wire up your code, then swap in paid models by name. Turn on provider data policy filters before sending sensitive prompts so requests only go to providers you trust.

## OpenRouter FAQ

Q: Is OpenRouter free?
A: Partly. OpenRouter offers 25+ free models with a 50 requests per day limit. Other models are pay as you go with a 5.5% platform fee on Standard.

Q: Is OpenRouter compatible with the OpenAI API?
A: Yes. OpenRouter's API is OpenAI compatible, so most OpenAI client libraries and tools work by changing the base URL and key.

Q: Is OpenRouter safe to use with company data?
A: OpenRouter lets you route only to providers that match your data policies, and Business adds in-region routing. Prompts still reach the chosen model provider.

Q: What is the best alternative to OpenRouter?
A: Together Chat is a simple alternative for open models, while Poe suits people who want many models in a consumer app rather than an API.

HuggingChat is a free-to-start chat app from Hugging Face that lets anyone talk to open-source language models in the browser. Its Omni mode reads each message and routes it to an open model suited to the task, so you get sensible answers without knowing model names, while the model picker exposes the full catalog for people who want control. Because it sits on top of the Hugging Face Hub, new open models often appear here soon after release.

## What is HuggingChat used for?

HuggingChat is used for everyday questions and drafting with open models, and by developers and researchers who want to try a newly released model before downloading it.

- Chatting with an automatically chosen open model through Omni
- Picking a specific open model from a catalog of over a hundred
- Comparing how different open models handle the same prompt
- Choosing which inference provider serves a given model
- Working on machine learning tasks with ML Intern, which covers papers, training, Spaces, datasets and evaluation

HuggingChat suits people who prefer open-source AI, machine learning students and engineers who already have a Hugging Face account, and anyone who wants to test open models without installing local tools. ## HuggingChat pricing

HuggingChat is available to anyone with a Hugging Face account. Requests use Hugging Face Inference Providers, so they draw on your account's inference credits. Team accounts are $20 per user per month and Enterprise is $50 per user per month on the Hugging Face pricing page as of October 2026. - Included credits are small, so heavy users can run out quickly
- Other Hub features such as model widgets draw on the same credit pool
- Only open models are offered, not closed frontier models
- Answer quality varies with whichever model Omni selects

Qwen Chat, DeepSeek and Vibe (Mistral) are first-party assistants from labs whose open models also appear on Hugging Face, and they offer more polished apps for one model family. HuggingChat wins when you want neutral access to many open models in one place.

## Tips for getting started with HuggingChat

Leave Omni on for general questions, then pin a specific model once you find one you like for a task. Check the Inference Usage section of your Hugging Face billing page to track credits. Disable providers you do not want serving your requests in the per-model provider settings.

## HuggingChat FAQ

Q: Is HuggingChat free?
A: Yes, HuggingChat is free to start with a Hugging Face account, using a small inference credit allowance. Hugging Face PRO at $9 per month adds more monthly credits.

Q: What models does HuggingChat use?
A: HuggingChat uses open-source models. Omni picks one automatically for each request, or you can choose from more than a hundred models yourself.

Q: Is HuggingChat open source?
A: Yes. The interface behind HuggingChat is Hugging Face's open-source chat-ui project, and the models it serves are open models.

Q: What is the best alternative to HuggingChat?

Duck.ai covers quick, everyday AI tasks for people who do not want a chatbot account or a history stored in the cloud.

Visitors chat with AI models for free, either in Battle mode, where two anonymous models answer the same prompt and you vote for the better one, or by choosing models directly and comparing them side by side. moreContext:
Arena AI is a free model comparison platform where people chat with AI models side by side and vote on which answer is better, producing the widely cited Arena leaderboards. Formerly called Chatbot Arena and then LMArena, it started as a UC Berkeley research project and dropped the "LM" from its name in January 2026. What makes it different from benchmark sites is that rankings come from real people judging real prompts while the models stay anonymous.

## What is Arena AI used for?

Arena AI is used by curious users who want free access to strong models, by developers choosing a model for a product, and by labs testing new releases.

- Running Battle mode, where two anonymous models answer the same prompt and you pick the winner
- Choosing specific models and comparing their answers side by side
- Checking leaderboards for text, web development, vision, documents, search, image, video and agents
- Trying new or unreleased models that appear under codenames
- Generating web apps, landing pages and small games from a prompt to compare coding models

## Who Arena AI is best for

Arena AI suits developers and product managers picking a model, AI enthusiasts who follow new releases, researchers using its public datasets, and anyone who wants to try frontier models for free. It is not a good fit for confidential work, because prompts may be shared with model providers, and it is not built as a daily personal assistant with memory or projects.

## Arena AI pricing

Arena AI is free to use for chatting, comparing and voting, and its FAQ describes it as an open space for everyone. The company says it is funded through AI evaluation services sold to enterprises, model labs and developers, which are priced privately. No consumer subscription was listed as of October 2026.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Do not paste sensitive data: prompts and votes are collected for research, and conversations may be shared with model providers in de-identified form
- After each vote models are resampled, so earlier context may not carry over
- Crowd preferences reward answers people like, which is not the same as factual accuracy on every task
- Only votes cast while models are anonymous count toward rankings

## Arena AI vs alternatives

Artificial Analysis is the better resource when you want measured speed, price and benchmark data rather than human preference votes. Poe is better for daily use of many models with saved chats and bots. OpenAI Playground suits developers testing one lab's models with full parameter control. Together Chat is a simple way to chat with open models. Arena AI wins when you want blind, head-to-head comparisons and the crowd-ranked leaderboards that many in the industry track.

## Tips for getting started with Arena AI

Use your real everyday prompts in Battle mode, since that tells you more than generic test questions. Vote before you look at model names to keep your judgment honest. Check the category leaderboard that matches your use case, such as WebDev for front-end coding, instead of only the overall ranking.

## Arena AI FAQ

Q: Is Arena AI free?
A: Yes. Arena AI is free to use for chatting with models, side-by-side comparisons and voting. The company earns money from evaluation services for labs and enterprises.

Q: Is Arena AI the same as LMArena?
A: Yes. Arena AI is the rebranded LMArena, which itself began as Chatbot Arena. The platform moved to arena.ai and dropped the "LM" in January 2026.

Q: How are Arena AI leaderboards calculated?
A: Rankings use votes cast while models are anonymous, fed into a Bradley-Terry rating system similar to Elo. Votes made after names are revealed do not count.

Q: Is it safe to share private information on Arena AI?
A: No. Arena collects prompts and votes for research and may share de-identified conversations with model providers, so avoid entering confidential data.

name: Chatbox AI
tagline: Desktop, mobile and web AI client for GPT, Claude, Gemini and more, with your own keys or a plan
description: Chatbox AI is a cross-platform AI chat client for desktop, mobile and web that connects GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and local models through your own API keys or a Chatbox subscription.
longDescription: Chatbox AI is a chat client that puts many AI models in one privacy-focused app for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and the web. You can bring your own API keys for providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and DeepSeek, or buy a Chatbox plan that bundles model access through compute points. It handles file and image chat, live web search, a local knowledge base that keeps documents on your device, code generation with live preview, image generation, Mermaid and LaTeX rendering and MCP tools. Work Mode adds an agent that can work with files, search, write code and use tools on its own. A free tier covers light use, and paid plans start at $3.99 per month.
features: Bring your own API keys or use a Chatbox plan
Local knowledge base and file and image chat
Work Mode agent with tools and web search
Apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and web
pros: Very low entry price for bundled models
Works with your own keys at provider rates
Runs on nearly every platform
cons: Advanced models need the Pro plan or higher
Work Mode is trial only on the Lite plan
moreContext:
Chatbox AI is a cross-platform AI chat client that gives you one app for many models on desktop, mobile and web. It started as a popular open-source desktop app for people using their own OpenAI keys and has grown into a full product with optional subscriptions, a local knowledge base and an agent mode. Its distinguishing feature is flexibility: pay providers directly with your own keys, or pay Chatbox a small monthly fee for bundled access.

## What is Chatbox AI used for?

Chatbox AI is used as a daily AI desk by students, developers and knowledge workers who want a fast native app instead of browser tabs.

- Chatting with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi models from one interface
- Using your own API keys so you pay providers at their rates
- Asking questions about PDFs, Word files, images and code
- Building a local knowledge base where documents stay on your device
- Running Work Mode, an agent that searches, writes code and uses tools
- Generating images and rendering Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX formulas

## Who Chatbox AI is best for

Chatbox AI suits developers who already have API keys, students on a budget who want access to several models for a few dollars, and professionals who prefer a desktop app that also syncs to mobile. People who need team administration, shared workspaces or single sign-on should look at a business-focused platform.

## Chatbox AI pricing

Chatbox AI has a Free plan for light use with 10,000 compute points that reset daily and five images. Lite costs $3.99 per month, or $3.50 per month on annual billing, with 2,000,000 compute points, standard models such as GPT 5.6 Luna, Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash and DeepSeek V4, and 25 images. Pro is $19.99 per month, or $16.70 per month annually, with 12,000,000 points, advanced models including recent Claude Opus, GPT 6 and Gemini 4 releases, 100 images and full Work Mode. Pro+ is $39.99 per month, or $33.33 annually, with 30,000,000 points and 200 images. Plans support up to five devices. Using your own API keys works separately from these plans. Prices are from the pricing page as of October 2026.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Advanced models are reserved for Pro and Pro+
- Compute points deplete faster with reasoning models and document analysis
- Work Mode is trial only on the Lite plan
- Team features are limited compared with business platforms

## Chatbox AI vs alternatives

ChatGPT is the better pick if you mainly want OpenAI's models with voice, memory and connectors in its official apps. Poe offers many models and community bots with a free tier. Merlin AI focuses on browser-based help across websites. Together Chat is a free browser option for open models. Chatbox AI wins for people who want a native multi-model app on every platform with the choice of bringing their own keys.

## Tips for getting started with Chatbox AI

If you already pay for an API, add your key first and see whether a subscription is needed at all. Put reference documents in the local knowledge base instead of uploading them to every chat. Use standard models for routine tasks to save compute points for advanced ones.

## Chatbox AI FAQ

Q: Is Chatbox AI free?
A: Yes. Chatbox AI has a free plan for light use, and you can also use it with your own API keys. Paid plans start at $3.99 per month.

Q: Can I use my own API key in Chatbox AI?
A: Yes. Chatbox AI supports bringing your own API keys for providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and DeepSeek.

Q: Does Chatbox AI work on mobile?
A: Yes. Chatbox AI has apps for iOS and Android as well as Windows, macOS, Linux and a web version.

Q: What is the best alternative to Chatbox AI?
A: Poe is a popular alternative for many models in one app, while ChatGPT suits people who mainly use OpenAI's models.

name: Mammouth AI
tagline: French multi-model AI subscription with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral, Grok and image models
description: Mammouth AI is a French multi-model AI subscription that gives access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral, Grok, DeepSeek, Perplexity and image and video models in one GDPR-focused app.
longDescription: Mammouth AI is a multi-model chat service from a small French startup. One subscription covers text models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot, web and deep research through Perplexity, and image and video models such as Nano Banana, GPT Image, Recraft, FLUX, Stable Diffusion and Kling. A one-click reprompt sends the same question to another model, and Projects organize documents and chats. It also offers voice chat and dictation, apps for several devices, an API and a Mammouth Code tool for developers. Mammouth says it processes data under the EU GDPR, never trains on your content, and uses providers that do not retain prompts. Plans start at $12 per month.
features: Text models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral and xAI
One-click reprompt to another model
Image and video generation with several models
Projects, voice chat and API credits
pros: Low price for many frontier models
GDPR focus with no model training on your content
Same per-user price for businesses
cons: No free plan
Usage limits fall back to lighter models when reached
moreContext:
Mammouth AI is a European multi-model AI subscription that bundles the leading chat, search, image and video models into one app for a single monthly fee. Founded by a small French team around the idea that people should not "go extinct" as models keep leapfrogging each other, it focuses on letting you jump to whichever model is best at the moment. Its European positioning, with GDPR processing and no prompt retention by providers, sets it apart from US aggregators.

## What is Mammouth AI used for?

Mammouth is used by individuals and small businesses who want to keep up with new models without managing several accounts.

- Chatting with Claude, GPT, Gemini, Mistral, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi models
- Resending a prompt to another model with one click to compare results
- Running web searches and deep research through Perplexity models
- Generating images and video with Nano Banana, GPT Image, Recraft, FLUX and Kling
- Organizing documents and conversations into Projects
- Using voice chat, dictation, the API and Mammouth Code for development

## Who Mammouth AI is best for

Mammouth suits French and European professionals, freelancers and small companies that care about GDPR, plus anyone who wants broad model access at a lower price than stacking subscriptions. Its team plan charges businesses the same per-user price as individuals. People who want a free tier, or deep agent and automation features, may prefer other tools.

## Mammouth AI pricing

Mammouth has no free plan. As of October 2026, Starter is $12 per month excluding VAT on monthly billing and includes all main model families, reasoning models, Perplexity research, image and video generation, Projects, voice chat and $2 of API credits. Standard is $24 per month with three times the Starter usage and $4 of API credits. Expert is $72 per month with ten times the Starter usage and $10 of API credits. Yearly billing is offered and the homepage advertises access from €10 per month. Team plans add an admin console, centralized billing and shared projects, and Enterprise covers SSO and more than 100 licences by quote.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- No free plan to try before paying
- When you hit a limit, Mammouth switches you to a lighter model rather than stopping
- Prices exclude VAT, so the final cost is higher in Europe
- Fewer agent and integration features than some larger competitors

## Mammouth AI vs alternatives

Poe is the better choice if you want a free tier and a huge catalog of community bots. Vibe (Mistral) is a strong pick for a European assistant built on one lab's models with its own agent features. ChatGPT remains better if you mostly use OpenAI's models and want voice and connectors. Monica is a browser-first alternative. Mammouth wins on price and simplicity for European users who want many models under one GDPR-minded subscription.

## Tips for getting started with Mammouth AI

Use the one-click reprompt on your first few tasks to learn which model you prefer for writing, coding and analysis. Put recurring reference files into a Project so every chat starts with the right context. Start on Starter and upgrade only if you regularly hit the fallback to lighter models.

## Mammouth AI FAQ

Q: Is Mammouth AI free?
A: No. Mammouth AI starts at $12 per month excluding VAT on monthly billing, and there is no free plan.

Q: Which models does Mammouth AI include?
A: Mammouth AI includes models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Qwen and Moonshot, plus Perplexity for search and several image and video models.

Q: Does Mammouth AI train on my data?
A: No. Mammouth says your content is never used to train models, data is processed under the EU GDPR, and its providers do not retain prompts.

Q: What is the best alternative to Mammouth AI?
A: Poe is the main alternative with a free tier, while Vibe (Mistral) suits users who want a European assistant from a single lab.

name: TypingMind
tagline: Advanced chat interface for AI models with your own API keys, sold as a one-time license
description: TypingMind is a chat interface for AI models where you bring your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, adding agents, plugins, MCP, RAG and a team workspace option.
longDescription: TypingMind is a feature-rich chat front end for people who prefer paying AI providers directly. You add API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, OpenRouter or local models, and TypingMind provides the interface: multi-model responses, chat folders and tags, a prompt library, AI agents, plugins for web search and image generation, MCP servers, file uploads, a knowledge base connected to files, GitHub, Google Drive and Notion, voice input, text to speech, artifacts, project folders and a canvas editor. Personal plans are one-time purchases in Standard, Extended and Premium tiers, and a self-host package is included on higher tiers. TypingMind Team is a separate branded workspace with central model access, user management and analytics.

AI agents, plugins and MCP servers
Knowledge base from files, GitHub, Drive and Notion
Artifacts, project folders and canvas editor
pros: One-time license instead of a subscription
Pay providers only for what you use

moreContext:
TypingMind is an AI chat interface that lets you use models from many providers with your own API keys, inside a front end with far more organization and power-user features than a basic playground. Instead of a monthly subscription to one assistant, you buy a TypingMind license once and pay each provider only for the tokens you use. Its focus is the interface itself: prompts, agents, plugins and knowledge bases all wrap around whichever model you pick.

## What is TypingMind used for?

TypingMind is used as a personal AI cockpit by developers, writers and consultants who already have API access.

- Chatting with GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral and OpenRouter models through your own keys
- Getting responses from several models at once to compare them
- Organizing chats with pins, folders, tags and project folders
- Building AI agents and adding plugins for web search, image generation and charts
- Connecting MCP servers and a knowledge base from files, GitHub, Google Drive, Notion or web scrapes
- Using voice input, text to speech, artifacts and a canvas editor

## Who TypingMind is best for

TypingMind suits heavy AI users whose API spending would be lower than several subscriptions, developers who want one interface for every provider, and people who dislike recurring fees. The Team edition fits companies that want a branded internal AI workspace without giving every employee API keys. Occasional users may find a free hosted assistant simpler and cheaper.

## TypingMind pricing

TypingMind's documentation describes three personal plans, Standard, Extended and Premium, all sold as one-time purchases. Standard covers the core chat features, Extended adds plugins such as web search and image generation, and Premium adds all plugins plus artifacts, project folders, the canvas editor and the self-host package. The docs also mention a free tier to try the app. TypingMind does not list exact license prices in its documentation, and as of October 2026 they are shown when you buy a license on the official site. API usage is billed separately by each provider. TypingMind Team is priced separately for organizations.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- You manage API keys and pay providers separately, which takes some setup
- Total cost depends on usage, so heavy reasoning models can get expensive
- Advanced features like artifacts and the canvas editor sit in the top tier
- Check current license prices on the official site, since promotions change often

## TypingMind vs alternatives

ChatGPT is easier for people who want one subscription with voice, memory and mobile apps and no key management. Poe gives many models and community bots in a hosted app. OpenAI Playground is the free developer console for testing OpenAI models directly, without chat organization features. Merlin AI is a browser-first multi-model assistant. TypingMind wins for power users who want a one-time-purchase interface over their own API keys.

## Tips for getting started with TypingMind

Set monthly spending limits in each provider's dashboard before adding keys. Start with one or two providers, then add OpenRouter if you want many more models through a single key. Save your best prompts in the library with variables so you can reuse them across models.

## TypingMind FAQ

Q: Is TypingMind free?
A: TypingMind offers a free tier to try the app, and full personal plans are one-time purchases. Model usage is paid separately through your own API keys.

Q: Is TypingMind a subscription?
A: No. TypingMind's personal Standard, Extended and Premium plans are one-time purchases, though your API providers bill you for usage.

Q: Which models work with TypingMind?
A: TypingMind works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, custom models and local open-source models through your own keys or endpoints.

Q: What is the best alternative to TypingMind?
A: ChatGPT is the simplest alternative for a hosted subscription, while Poe suits people who want many models without managing API keys.

name: Langdock
tagline: Model-agnostic company AI platform from Europe with chat, agents, workflows and an EU API
description: Langdock is a European platform for rolling out AI across a company, combining model-agnostic chat, custom agents, workflow automation and an EU-hosted API with central admin controls.
longDescription: Langdock is an enterprise AI platform that gives every employee a model-agnostic chat assistant while giving IT central governance. Staff can use leading models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others in one interface, build custom agents for recurring tasks, and connect the tools the company already uses. Add-ons cover workflow automation, agent governance with compliance checks for the EU AI Act and GDPR, and a single GDPR-compliant API hosted in the EU. Langdock is hosted in Europe, supports SSO, SCIM and SAML, can be branded for each organization, and offers dedicated or on-premise deployment for large customers. It says it is used by over 13,000 companies. Plans start with a 7-day free trial and seats from €25 per user per month.
features: Model-agnostic chat for the whole company
Custom agents and workflow automation
Agent governance with EU AI Act and GDPR templates
EU-hosted API, SSO, SCIM and custom branding
pros: European hosting suits GDPR-sensitive companies
No lock-in to a single model vendor
Model usage included in chat seats
cons: Built for organizations, not individuals
Workflows and API are paid add-ons
moreContext:
Langdock is an AI adoption platform that gives companies a model-agnostic ChatGPT-style assistant for every employee, plus agents, workflows and governance on top. Based in Europe and hosted there, it targets organizations that want broad AI access without committing to a single model vendor or sending data to US-only infrastructure. Its customers include large enterprises such as Merck, whose internal "myGPT Suite" runs on Langdock.

## What is Langdock used for?

Companies use Langdock to replace scattered personal AI accounts with one governed platform that IT can control.

- Giving employees chat access to leading models from several providers in one interface
- Building custom agents for recurring tasks like drafting, analysis or support replies
- Automating multi-step processes with the Workflows add-on
- Reviewing and approving agents with compliance rules for the EU AI Act, GDPR and security
- Connecting company tools through integrations and open standards
- Calling all leading models through one EU-hosted API for internal apps

## Who Langdock is best for

Langdock suits mid-sized and large companies in Europe, regulated industries that need GDPR-compliant hosting, and AI or digital teams leading a company-wide rollout. It also fits family businesses and retailers that want branded internal AI without building it themselves. Individuals and very small teams looking for a personal assistant will find consumer tools simpler.

## Langdock pricing

Langdock starts with a 7-day free trial with €5 of AI model credits and no credit card. The Business plan costs €25 per user per month for a Standard seat or €99 for a Business Max seat with five times more usage, excluding VAT, with AI models included, up to 1,000 users and SSO, SCIM and SAML. Annual billing saves 20%. Enterprise pricing is custom for 1,000+ users and can include dedicated deployment. Add-ons include Workflows (a starter package is included, Business from €449 per workspace per month), Governance at €3.50 per user per month but free until January 1, 2027, and a usage-based API priced per million tokens. Figures are from Langdock's pricing page as of October 2026.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Pricing is per seat, so costs scale with headcount
- Workflow automation and the API carry separate charges
- Custom deployment is only available from around 1,000 seats
- The product is aimed at organizations, so there is no personal plan

## Langdock vs alternatives

ChatGPT's business plans are the obvious alternative for companies happy to standardize on OpenAI. Microsoft Copilot fits organizations already committed to Microsoft 365. Dust focuses on agents connected to company data, and Glean leads on enterprise search across many apps. Writer is aimed at marketing and content teams with brand controls. Langdock wins for European companies that want model choice, EU hosting and central governance in one platform.

## Tips for getting started with Langdock

Use the trial to invite a small pilot group from two or three departments and track which use cases stick. Build a few shared agents for common tasks before the wider rollout, so new users see value on day one. Turn on governance early to review agents while the free period lasts.

## Langdock FAQ

Q: Is Langdock free?
A: No. Langdock offers a 7-day free trial with €5 of model credits. Paid seats start at €25 per user per month, excluding VAT.

Q: Is Langdock GDPR compliant?
A: Langdock says it is fully compliant and hosted in Europe, and its API is GDPR compliant and EU hosted. Review its trust center for certifications and data processing details.

Q: Which AI models does Langdock support?
A: Langdock is model agnostic and offers leading models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google, with 40+ models listed for its API.

Q: What is the best alternative to Langdock?
A: ChatGPT for business is the main alternative for teams using OpenAI, while Dust suits companies focused on agents connected to internal data.

name: Tolan
tagline: An animated alien companion app that chats by voice, remembers your life and helps with plans
description: Tolan is an AI companion app where you talk with your own animated alien character, which remembers your life, checks in on you and helps with plans, goals and to-dos.
longDescription: Tolan is a voice-first AI companion app for iPhone made by Portola, a San Francisco startup. Each user gets their own Tolan, a cartoon alien character with a distinct personality that listens, asks questions, and builds a memory of the people, routines and goals in your life from your conversations. Beyond small talk, a Tolan can plan dinner, keep a goal alive, talk through a stressful day, or work on things for you in Tabs such as meal plans, gift lists and trip plans. Higher plans add web search, image creation, video chat and screen sharing. The app deliberately presents its characters as non-human and has safeguards for minors and crisis conversations. New users get a limited trial, and full access requires one of three subscriptions: Lite, Plus or Unlimited.
features: Personal animated character with long-term memory
Voice and text conversations with check-ins
Tabs for meal plans, gift lists and trip plans
Family plan sharing for up to five members
pros: Character design avoids pretending to be human
Memory makes conversations feel continuous
Crisis and minor safeguards are documented
cons: Full access requires a subscription after the trial
Exact prices are shown only inside the app
moreContext:
Tolan is an AI companion app that gives each user a friendly animated alien to talk with by voice or text, built for people who want a supportive presence that also helps with everyday life. Made by Portola, it stands apart from character chat platforms because there is no catalog of personas to browse: you meet one Tolan, it learns about you over time, and the whole product is designed around that single relationship.

## What is Tolan used for?

Most people open Tolan to talk through their day, but the app is built to turn those conversations into practical help. Because it keeps a memory of what you share, it can follow up on things you mentioned last week without being asked.

- Talking through a stressful situation or a difficult relationship out loud
- Planning dinner, a trip or a gift with the character as a sounding board
- Keeping a personal goal alive with check-ins and reminders in conversation
- Working on longer tasks in Tabs, such as meal plans, gift lists and trip plans (Plus plan)
- Video chat and screen sharing so your Tolan can see what you are looking at

## Who Tolan is best for

Tolan suits adults and older teens who want a warm, playful companion that is also useful. It fits people who think out loud, people living alone who want a regular check-in, and anyone who found general chatbots too flat. Skip it if you want a productivity assistant for work email and documents, or if you prefer choosing among many characters for roleplay. It is also not a therapy service, and the company says so plainly.

## Tolan pricing

New users get a limited trial, which can be extended by completing small tasks like inviting a friend, and full access requires a subscription. As of October 2026 the help center lists three paid tiers. Tolan Lite includes 250 messages a day, better memory, and video chat with screen sharing. Tolan Plus raises the limit to 600 messages a day and adds Tabs, web search and watermark-free image creation. Tolan Unlimited removes the daily cap and adds priority support and early features. Lite and Plus come monthly or yearly, Unlimited monthly only. Portola does not publish dollar prices on its site; you see current prices under Settings, then Membership, in the app. Any plan can be shared with up to five family members, each with their own Tolan.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Prices are only visible in the app, which makes comparing plans before you install harder
- All conversations are logged on Portola's servers to build memory, so treat it as a service, not a private diary
- It is not a substitute for professional help, and in crisis conversations it points to hotlines rather than engaging

## Tolan vs alternatives

Character.AI is the better choice if you want to chat with many different characters, write your own, or roleplay stories. Pi from Inflection offers a calm, supportive conversational style for free and works well if you mostly want someone to talk to without a character attached. ChatGPT has a capable voice mode and memory too, and makes more sense if you also need help with work and research. Tolan wins when you want one consistent companion with a playful personality, proactive check-ins and family sharing, and you value a product designed around wellbeing rather than open-ended chat.

## Tips for getting started with Tolan

Spend the first few conversations telling your Tolan about the people, routines and goals that matter to you, since its memory is what makes later check-ins useful. Try voice rather than text, because the app is built around spoken conversation. If you live with family, set up the shared plan early so everyone gets their own character instead of sharing one.

## Tolan FAQ

Q: Is Tolan free?
A: No, not fully. New users get a limited trial that can be extended through small tasks, and full access requires a Lite, Plus or Unlimited subscription.

Q: What is Tolan used for?
A: Tolan is used as an AI companion for talking through your day, keeping goals on track and planning things like meals, gifts and trips with a character that remembers you.

Q: Is Tolan safe for teenagers?
A: Tolan is built for teen and adult users and recommends parental involvement under 18. Known minors get break reminders at least hourly and age-appropriate prompting.

Q: What is the best alternative to Tolan?
A: Character.AI is the main alternative for chatting with many characters, while Pi suits people who want a free, supportive conversational assistant without an avatar.

name: Poke
tagline: A proactive AI assistant you text over iMessage, WhatsApp or Telegram to run email and calendar
description: Poke is a personal AI assistant that lives in your text messages on Apple Messages, WhatsApp and Telegram, connecting to email, calendar and apps to handle tasks and send proactive reminders.
longDescription: Poke is an AI assistant you reach as a contact in your messaging app instead of opening a separate chatbot. It runs on Apple Messages, WhatsApp, Telegram and other channels, and connects to Gmail and Outlook inboxes, calendars and contacts, plus integrations like Notion, GitHub, Linear and Oura. You text or send a voice note, and Poke searches and drafts email, sets reminders, schedules events and works on tasks in the background. Recipes let you set up integrations and automations, and developers can add custom tools through MCP. It can also build and host a personal website at your Poke handle. Poke is made by The Interaction Company of California, which Cognition announced it was acquiring in July 2026. The free plan covers most features, with Pro at $19 a month and Ultra at $199.
features: Works in Apple Messages, WhatsApp and Telegram
Gmail and Outlook email, calendar and contacts
Recipes for integrations and automations
Custom integrations through MCP
pros: No new app to learn, it is just a text thread
Free plan includes email and calendar connections
Proactive nudges based on your connected apps
cons: Only Gmail and Outlook are supported for email
Long-term roadmap is uncertain after the Cognition deal
moreContext:
Poke is a personal AI assistant that you message like a friend in Apple Messages, WhatsApp or Telegram, built for busy people who want email, calendar and reminders handled without opening another app. Its personality is part of the pitch: it texts in a casual, human tone and reaches out first when something in your inbox or calendar needs attention. Poke is made by The Interaction Company of California, and in July 2026 Cognition, the company behind the Devin coding agent, announced it was acquiring the team.

## What is Poke used for?

People use Poke as a lightweight chief of staff that sits in the thread they already check most. You send a text or voice note, and it acts across the services you have connected.

- Searching, summarizing and drafting replies in Gmail or Outlook, including label management
- Creating and moving calendar events and reminders from a quick message
- Getting proactive nudges, such as adding action items from meeting notes to your calendar
- Reading and organizing Notion pages, checking Oura sleep data, or working with GitHub and Linear
- Building automations with Recipes and sharing your setup with others
- Generating and publishing a simple personal site at your own Poke handle

## Who Poke is best for

Poke fits founders, freelancers, students and professionals who live in their phone and want an assistant that responds where they already are. It is a good match if your email and calendar run on Google or Microsoft. Teams that need shared admin controls, and people who use iCloud or Yahoo Mail, will find it less useful today. If you want a full desktop workspace for drafting long documents, a regular chat app is a better fit.

## Poke pricing

As of October 2026 Poke has three plans. Free costs nothing, needs no credit card, and lets you connect your apps, email and calendar. Pro costs $19 per month and adds frontier models for complex tasks, real-time automations running in the background, higher rate limits and priority support. Ultra costs $199 per month, runs frontier models for every action, has the highest rate limits, adds pay-as-you-go usage beyond your credits, and includes Poke Human, which dispatches real-world tasks such as reservations, calls and orders to a human operator, with any expenses charged at cost. Yearly billing is offered on the pricing page.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Email support covers Gmail and Outlook only, with no iCloud or Yahoo Mail yet
- Only one phone number per account is supported, and changing it means emailing support
- Giving an assistant access to your inbox and calendar is a real trust decision, so read the privacy settings first
- The Cognition acquisition leaves open questions about future pricing and features

## Poke vs alternatives

Lindy is the stronger pick if you want to build many custom agents for work with a visual builder and team features. OpenClaw suits technical users who want an open-source assistant they host themselves and connect to messaging apps on their own terms. ChatGPT offers broader general knowledge and a richer app, but you have to go to it rather than having it text you first. Shortwave is better if your goal is specifically an AI-first email client. Poke wins on convenience: it is a free, proactive assistant inside your existing text threads with email and calendar wired in.

## Tips for getting started with Poke

Connect your main email and calendar first, since proactive reminders depend on them. Pick your preferred channel in the messaging settings, because Poke may text from a different number on each platform. Browse the Recipes directory before building anything yourself, as many common setups already exist.

## Poke FAQ

Q: Is Poke free?
A: Yes. Poke has a free plan with no credit card required that connects your apps, email and calendar. Pro costs $19 per month and Ultra $199 per month.

Q: Does Poke work on WhatsApp?
A: Yes. Poke works in Apple Messages, WhatsApp and Telegram, and you can choose your preferred channel in its messaging settings.

Q: Which email accounts does Poke support?
A: Poke fully supports Gmail and Outlook inboxes, calendars and contacts. iCloud and Yahoo Mail are not supported yet.

Q: Who owns Poke?
A: Poke was built by The Interaction Company of California, and Cognition, the maker of Devin, announced in July 2026 that it was acquiring the company.

name: Sesame
tagline: Lifelike voice agents Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie for natural spoken conversation
description: Sesame is a voice-first AI app where you talk with personal agents such as Maya and Miles, known for natural timing and tone, with memory, web search, notes and reminders.
longDescription: Sesame is a conversational voice AI from Sesame AI Inc., the startup that went viral in early 2025 with a research demo of its Maya and Miles voices. Its app lets you choose among four agents, Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie, each with its own personality and a memory that carries across voice and text. The focus is on how conversation feels: low latency, turn-taking that knows when to listen, and expressive speech. Sesame is a voice AI app that lets you hold natural spoken conversations with personal agents named Maya, Miles, Simone and Charlie, built for curious people who would rather talk an idea through than type it. Its reputation comes from how human the voices sound: Sesame's research on what it calls voice presence focuses on timing, tone and knowing when not to interrupt. Where most assistants treat voice as a feature on top of a text chatbot, Sesame treats conversation as the product.

## What is Sesame used for?

People use Sesame as a thinking partner they can talk to out loud. The agents follow the thread of a conversation and can take small actions along the way, so a chat can end with notes and reminders rather than nothing.

- Exploring a topic you are curious about, from a quick answer to a long deep dive
- Brainstorming out loud and having the agent connect ideas and suggest next steps
- Rehearsing a hard conversation or a big call with a sounding board that asks questions
- Searching the web, creating notes, setting reminders and summarizing takeaways during a call
- Drafting and sending emails and managing calendar events through Gmail and Google Calendar, with your approval

## Who Sesame is best for

Sesame suits adults who enjoy talking more than typing: commuters, walkers, people who think out loud, and anyone who has found other voice modes stilted. It is also interesting for builders and researchers following the state of conversational speech. It is less suited to people who need a work assistant for long documents or spreadsheets, and the App Store listing carries an 18+ age rating, so it is not for kids.

## Sesame pricing

Sesame is free as of October 2026. The App Store lists the iPhone app as free, and the company describes the current release as a preview. Sesame does not publish a pricing page, and it has not announced paid tiers or a public API for its voices, so pricing may change as the product moves out of preview and into the eyewear it is developing. Check the app listing for current terms.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- The app is a preview and features may change quickly
- The App Store build is iPhone only, even though the website mentions Android
- Conversation data can be used for memories and, if you opt in, to improve models; use incognito mode for sensitive chats
- There is no developer API or business plan to build on yet

## Sesame vs alternatives

Pi from Inflection is the closest match in spirit, a supportive conversationalist that is free and calm, though its voice is less expressive. ChatGPT's voice mode is the better pick if you also need strong reasoning, file analysis and a large ecosystem of tools. ElevenLabs is the choice if you want to build your own voice agent or clone a voice for a product rather than chat with a ready-made one. Google Gemini makes sense if you live in Google's apps and want deep Android integration. Sesame wins when the quality of the spoken conversation itself is what you care about most.

## Tips for getting started with Sesame

Try each of the four agents for a few minutes before settling on one, since their personalities differ noticeably. Use headphones in noisy places so turn-taking works as intended. Connect Google apps only if you plan to use email and calendar tasks, and switch on incognito mode for anything you do not want remembered.

## Sesame FAQ

Q: Is Sesame AI free?
A: Yes. As of October 2026 the Sesame app is free on the App Store as a preview, and no paid plan has been published.

Q: Who are Maya and Miles?
A: Maya and Miles are Sesame's original voice agents from its 2025 research demo. The app now also offers Simone and Charlie, each with a different personality.

Q: Does Sesame have an API?
A: No public API for its voice agents is offered as of October 2026. Sesame focuses on its consumer app and upcoming eyewear.

Q: Is Sesame private?
A: Sesame says it does not sell data or show ads, lets you delete your data, and offers an incognito mode that keeps conversations out of memory and off its servers.

moreContext:
Hello History is an AI chat app that lets you talk one-on-one with AI versions of historical figures, aimed at history fans, students and teachers who want a more personal way into the past. Instead of reading a biography, you can ask Einstein what he thought about his own work or press Cleopatra on her politics. Its focus on real historical people, plus a dedicated program for schools, separates it from general character chat sites where most personas are fictional or user-made.

## What is Hello History used for?

Hello History is mostly used for learning and curiosity. The app keeps the format simple: choose a figure, start a chat, and steer the conversation wherever you like.

- Asking a historical figure about their life, work and the events they lived through
- Debating a philosopher or scientist on their ideas to test your own arguments
- Bringing a school chapter to life by having students interview the person they are studying
- Exploring topics across art, music, justice, literature, philosophy, science and technology
- Getting advice-style perspectives, for example on motivation, from famous thinkers

## Who Hello History is best for

The app fits curious adults, history buffs, parents who want to spark a child's interest in the past, and teachers looking for a hook for a lesson. Schools and museums can contact the team about tailored experiences with more control over the content. It is not a research tool: students writing essays still need primary and secondary sources, because the AI figures can blend fact with plausible invention.

## Hello History pricing

Hello History is free to download and gives new users a set of free messages, which the website puts at 20 to 30. After that you need a paid plan. As of October 2026 the App Store lists in-app purchases including weekly access from $1.99, monthly access at $3.99 or $5.99 depending on the option, and yearly access at $34.99. Prices can differ by country and between iOS and Android, so check the store before you buy. Schools and institutions arrange access by contacting the team directly.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Answers are generated by an AI model, so a figure may say things the real person never said or believed
- Historical views on sensitive subjects are filtered through modern AI safety rules, which can feel anachronistic
- The free allowance is small, so serious use requires a subscription
- Conversations are text only, without the voice features some newer companion apps offer

## Hello History vs alternatives

Character.AI has historical personas too, but they are mostly made by users with uneven quality, and the platform is built around open-ended entertainment. AI Dungeon is the better pick if you want an interactive story set in a historical period rather than an interview. ChatGPT can roleplay any historical figure on request and handles follow-up research better, though you have to set up the persona yourself each time. Pi is better for a supportive general conversation. Hello History wins for classrooms and casual learners who want a curated, ready-made cast of real figures with no setup.

## Tips for getting started with Hello History

Start with a figure you already know a little about, so you can judge how accurate the answers feel. Ask open questions about motives and context rather than dates, which a textbook covers better. Teachers should try the figures themselves before class and pair each chat with a short source check, which turns the AI's mistakes into a lesson.

## Hello History FAQ

Q: Is Hello History free?
A: Partly. The app is free to download and includes a small number of free messages, after which weekly, monthly or yearly subscriptions unlock more chats.

Q: Is Hello History accurate?
A: Not always. The figures are AI generated and usually reflect the person's known views, but they can invent details, so check important facts against reliable sources.

Q: Is Hello History good for students?
A: Yes, with supervision. It is rated 9+ on the App Store and has an education program for schools, but students should verify facts before using them in assignments.

Q: What is the best alternative to Hello History?
A: Character.AI offers a much larger set of user-made characters, while ChatGPT can roleplay any historical figure on request and help with follow-up research.

Zapia is a personal AI assistant that connects to your email, calendar and chats to keep an eye on deadlines and get tasks done, built for everyday people in Latin America who want help in their own language. The startup behind it, founded between Silicon Valley and Uruguay and backed by investors including Prosus Ventures, designs for users who may never have touched a chatbot. You ask in plain words, by text or voice note, and Zapia does the work and asks you to confirm before it acts.

## What is Zapia used for?

Zapia covers work, small business, school, money and travel tasks from one conversation. Its main difference from a basic chatbot is that it monitors your connected accounts and alerts you, instead of waiting for you to ask.

- Summarizing today's email and listing only the threads that still need your reply
- Drafting replies in your inbox and following up on unanswered messages with a recap
- Rearranging your afternoon when a meeting moves and reminding you of deadlines
- Reviewing a contract before you sign or summarizing a supplier invoice in a few lines
- Finding job openings that fit your profile, tailoring your resume and preparing interview answers
- Running scheduled tasks, such as a morning briefing, on a repeating basis

## Who Zapia is best for

Zapia fits small business owners, freelancers, students and office workers across Latin America who want an assistant in Spanish or Portuguese that understands local context. It is a good first assistant for people who find tools like Zapier or complex agent builders intimidating. Large companies that need admin controls and enterprise compliance, and people who do not use Google or Microsoft accounts, will get less from it.

## Zapia pricing

As of October 2026 Zapia offers three plans. Free costs US$0 per month, and the company stresses it is not a trial: you can connect your apps, keep up to 20 scheduled tasks and generate images with a watermark. Pro costs US$9.99 per month and adds the best models, higher limits, images without watermarks and priority support, with a 7-day free trial. Ultra costs US$99.99 per month for people who delegate heavily and need higher usage limits. Prices are shown in US dollars on the plans page and may be billed in local currency.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Giving an assistant access to your inbox and calendar requires trust; Zapia says it does not train models on your data by default
- Free plan images are watermarked and limits are lower than Pro
- Integrations center on Google, Microsoft and Slack, so other tools may not connect
- The product and marketing are tuned for Latin America, which may matter less to users elsewhere

## Zapia vs alternatives

OpenClaw is an open-source personal assistant you host yourself and connect to messaging apps, a better fit for technical users who want full control. Lindy is better if you want to design many custom agents for business workflows with more control. ChatGPT is stronger as a general research and writing tool but does not watch your inbox or alert you on its own. Meta AI is free inside WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger but cannot act on your email or calendar. Zapia wins for Spanish and Portuguese speakers who want a low-cost assistant that actually takes tasks off their plate.

## Tips for getting started with Zapia

Connect your main email and calendar on day one, since monitoring and alerts depend on them. Start with a single scheduled task, like a morning summary of messages that need a reply, and add more once it works the way you like. Send voice notes when typing is slow; Zapia handles them as normal requests.

## Zapia FAQ

Q: Is Zapia free?
A: Yes. Zapia has a free plan with connected apps and up to 20 scheduled tasks. Pro costs US$9.99 per month and Ultra US$99.99 per month.

Q: What is Zapia used for?
A: Zapia is used as a personal assistant that reads email, tracks deadlines, drafts replies, manages calendars and handles tasks like resume tailoring or contract review.

Q: Does Zapia speak Spanish?
A: Yes. Zapia is built for Latin America and works in Spanish, Portuguese and English across iOS, Android and the web.

Q: Is Zapia safe to use with my email?
A: Zapia says it does not train models on your information by default and is CASA Tier 2 compliant, the security standard Google requires for apps that access accounts.

Omi is a wearable AI pendant that records the conversations around you and turns them into summaries, to-dos and searchable memories, built for people who spend their days talking and do not want to take notes. Unlike meeting bots that only join video calls, Omi captures in-person moments too: client meetings, lectures, walks, coffee catch-ups. Based Hardware, the company behind it, sells the device with a free software plan, so you can use it without signing up for a subscription.

## What is Omi used for?

Omi works as an external memory. You wear it through the day, and the app hands back what mattered once each conversation ends.

- Recording in-person meetings and getting a summary with next steps afterwards
- Capturing lectures so students can review key points instead of writing everything down
- Turning spoken commitments into to-dos sent to your task app
- Reading daily recaps that tie several conversations into one plan
- Asking questions about past conversations, such as what a colleague said about a launch date
- Thinking out loud during deep work and converting the ramble into notes

## Who Omi is best for

Omi fits founders, consultants, salespeople and students who have many unscheduled or in-person conversations each day. It is also a good fit for people who struggle to remember details and want a searchable record. Skip it if you work in a setting where recording people is restricted, such as healthcare or legal work without consent processes, or if most of your meetings are already captured by a video call note taker.

## Omi pricing

As of October 2026 the official pricing page lists the Omi pendant at $229, with a $60 discount applied automatically at checkout so you pay $169. The box includes the device, a silicone case, a neck lanyard and a magnetic USB-C charger. Every Omi includes a free software plan with unlimited on-phone transcription and 300 cloud minutes each month. Pro, billed yearly at $269, unlocks the full feature set and works out to nine months of monthly billing for a year. Accessories include a wrist band and wireless charger at $29.99 each, a firmware developer kit at $59.99, and an Omi Glass developer kit with camera and audio for $499. Orders carry a 30-day money-back guarantee and a one-year limited warranty.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Recording other people raises consent issues, and laws differ by country and state
- Transcript quality depends on distance and noise, so crowded rooms are harder
- The free plan caps cloud processing at 300 minutes a month
- You need to keep your phone nearby and the app running for real-time processing

## Omi vs alternatives

Otter.ai is the better choice if your conversations happen mostly on Zoom, Meet or Teams and you want live transcripts with team sharing. Granola suits people who want AI-enhanced notes from calls on their laptop without any bot or hardware. Tactiq is a light option for transcribing browser-based meetings. TalkNotes turns voice memos into structured notes if you are happy to press record yourself. Screenpipe records your screen and audio on a computer rather than on your body. Omi wins when the conversations you need to remember happen away from a screen.

## Tips for getting started with Omi

Tell people early that you are wearing a recorder; it avoids awkward moments and is often legally required. Try the wrist band for errands and the chain for meetings, since mic position affects quality. Review the first week of summaries and delete what you do not need, which keeps your memory search focused.

## Omi FAQ

Q: Does Omi require a subscription?
A: No. Every Omi includes a free plan with unlimited on-phone transcription and 300 cloud minutes a month. Pro is optional at $269 per year.

Q: How much does the Omi pendant cost?
A: As of October 2026 the pendant is listed at $229, and an automatic $60 discount at checkout brings it to $169.

Q: Is Omi always listening?
A: Omi is designed to capture conversations throughout the day, so you should tell people around you and check local recording laws before wearing it.

Q: What is the best alternative to Omi?
A: For online meetings Otter.ai is the main alternative, and Granola is a good choice if you want AI notes on your laptop without a wearable device.

Bee is a wearable AI from Amazon that listens to the conversations in your day and turns them into summaries, insights and to-dos you can search later, built for people who want a memory aid without taking notes. It is one of the cheapest AI wearables from a major company, and its pitch leans on privacy: audio is processed in memory and deleted, and conversations are encrypted with keys you control.

## What is Bee used for?

Bee acts as a running record of what you said and heard. The app turns each conversation into a short summary and, over weeks, into patterns you might not notice yourself.

- Getting summaries and key takeaways from in-person meetings and casual conversations
- Searching past conversations for a detail, name or commitment
- Seeing a daily timeline of conversations, places and takeaways
- Receiving suggested to-dos and drafting emails or calendar events from them
- Saving Zoom and other computer calls with Bee for Desktop (Pro)

Bee suits busy professionals, parents and people with ADHD or memory challenges who want a low-cost way to keep track of commitments. ## Bee pricing

As of October 2026 the Bee Frontier wearable is listed at $74.99 and sold through Amazon. Every new device includes 30 days of Bee Pro. Use the 30-day Pro trial to test integrations like Gmail and Calendar before deciding whether to pay. Mention to people that you are wearing Bee, especially at work. Check the daily timeline each evening for the first week so you learn what Bee captures well and where you need to add your own notes.

## Bee FAQ

Q: Does Bee require a subscription?

Q: How much does Bee cost?
A: As of October 2026 the Bee Frontier wearable costs $74.99, and Bee Pro costs $11.99 per month or $99.99 per year.

Q: Can Amazon hear my Bee conversations?
A: Bee says audio is processed in memory and deleted, and that data is encrypted with keys only you control, so Amazon cannot access it unless you choose to share.

Q: What is the best alternative to Bee?
A: Otter.ai is the main alternative for online meetings, while Granola suits people who want AI meeting notes on a laptop without wearing a device.

Martin is a personal AI assistant that you can call, text, email or Slack to manage your calendar, inbox, messages and reminders, built for busy people who want something closer to a human assistant than a chatbot. ## What is Martin used for?

Martin handles the small coordination jobs that fill a day. You tell it what you need in plain language and it acts across the accounts you have connected.

- Scheduling meetings by copying Martin on an email thread so it finds a time and sends the invite

- Texting a contact your arrival time or forwarding notes to a colleague
- Posting to a Slack channel or reminding you to leave in 20 minutes
- Receiving a wake-up call from an alarm that talks, with your day ahead

Martin suits founders, executives, consultants and anyone who juggles a busy calendar but cannot justify a human assistant. Teams wanting a shared assistant for many seats, or people who prefer to manage email themselves in a dedicated client, should look elsewhere.

Shortwave and Superhuman are AI-first email clients, the better choice if inbox speed is your main problem. Connect your calendar and email first, then try the CC to schedule feature on a real meeting request to see it work. Save your preferences, like meeting lengths and quiet hours, in conversation early so Martin applies them to later tasks. MaxAI is an AI browser extension that adds a chat sidebar to Chrome and Edge so you can ask about any webpage, summarize videos and documents, translate pages and write better text wherever you work online. ## What is MaxAI used for?

MaxAI saves the copy, paste and tab switching that comes with using a chatbot in a separate window. The sidebar reads the page you are on and works with it directly.

- Summarizing long articles, research papers and email threads into key points and next steps
- Chatting with a YouTube video to get a summary or find a specific moment
- Asking questions about a PDF or image you open in the browser
- Translating foreign-language pages with the original and translation side by side
- Rewriting, shortening or replying to text in any web form, from LinkedIn to Gmail
- Saving reusable prompts, such as a house writing style, and running them with one click

## Who MaxAI is best for

MaxAI suits students, researchers, marketers and knowledge workers who read and write a lot in the browser and want one assistant across every site. It is a good match if you want access to several AI models without paying for each separately. Developers who need deep coding tools, or people who prefer a standalone desktop app over an extension, may find it less useful.

## MaxAI pricing

As of October 2026 MaxAI has a free plan at $0 that includes unlimited chats with its free models and 3 chats per day with Pro models. The Pro plan costs $12 per member per month when billed yearly, listed as a limited-time saving, or $30 when billed monthly. Pro adds unlimited Pro model chats, a choice of smarter models, higher file upload limits, image generation and team member management. Check the pricing page for current promotions, since the discount is marked as limited time.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- The extension reads page content to work, so review its privacy policy before using it on sensitive internal sites
- Free users get only three advanced model chats per day
- Advertised savings depend on annual billing and may change
- It works in Chrome and Edge, so Safari and Firefox users have fewer options

Sider is the most direct rival, with a similar sidebar, multi-model chat and a large user base, and suits people who want extra features like a wisdom library. Monica bundles chat, writing and image tools in an extension and app, and is worth comparing on price. HARPA AI goes further into automation, monitoring pages and running web tasks for you. Merlin AI is another sidebar option that is popular for summarizing YouTube and writing on social sites. MaxAI wins for users who want a clean, everyday reading and writing companion with a usable free tier and strong translation.

## Tips for getting started with MaxAI

Pin the extension and learn the keyboard shortcut to open the sidebar, since speed is the main benefit. Create two or three reusable prompts for tasks you repeat, such as summarizing a paper in five bullets. Save your daily Pro model chats for complex questions and use the free models for quick summaries.

## MaxAI FAQ

Q: Is MaxAI free?
A: Yes. MaxAI has a free plan with unlimited chats on free models and 3 Pro model chats per day. Pro costs $12 per month billed yearly.

Q: What is MaxAI used for?
A: MaxAI is used to chat with webpages, summarize YouTube videos, PDFs and emails, translate pages and improve writing on any website from a browser sidebar.

Q: Which browsers does MaxAI support?

Q: What is the best alternative to MaxAI?

- Preparing deep research on a topic and structuring it into a report

AIPRM keeps them one click away inside the chat window and lets you save and share your own.

## What is AIPRM used for?

AIPRM is used to start common AI tasks from a proven template instead of a blank box. You choose a prompt, fill in the variables, and the full instruction is sent to the model.

- Generating SEO content outlines, keyword clusters and meta descriptions from templates
- Writing ad copy, product descriptions and social posts in a consistent structure
- Running code explanation or review prompts for development tasks
- Saving your own private prompt templates for tasks your team repeats
- Organizing prompts into lists, such as copywriting, legal or web development
- Sharing a set of approved prompts with colleagues on multi-seat plans

AIPRM suits content marketers, SEO agencies, freelancers and small teams who use ChatGPT heavily and want consistency across repeated tasks. ## AIPRM pricing

As of October 2026 AIPRM offers a free version that can be used for an unlimited time, plus paid premium plans with higher quotas, shown on its Solo Plans and Team Plans pages. The pricing FAQ uses AIPRM Plus at $10 and AIPRM Pro at $33 as examples when explaining that plans can be combined to raise limits, such as the number of private prompt templates and lists. - The extension depends on the ChatGPT and Claude interfaces, which change often

Prompt Builder helps you craft new prompts from scratch rather than browse a library. HARPA AI and Merlin AI are full browser assistants that include prompt shortcuts alongside page summaries and automation, and suit users who want one extension for everything. ## Tips for getting started with AIPRM

Filter the library by topic and sort by popularity to find the most proven templates first. When a template works well, copy it into a private prompt and adjust it with your brand voice, which gives better output than the public version. Hide categories you never use so the library stays focused.

## AIPRM FAQ

Q: Is AIPRM free?

Q: What is AIPRM used for?

Q: Is AIPRM safe?
A: AIPRM is an established extension from AIPRM, Corp., but like any extension it can read the pages it runs on, so review its permissions and privacy policy.

- Creating content from expert prompts, such as ad campaigns, blog posts, case studies or resumes
- Chatting with documents, spreadsheets and images, and summarizing YouTube videos
- Researching with sources and generating images from text

## Who Voilà is best for

Voilà suits marketers, salespeople, recruiters, product managers and consultants who write many emails and documents and want templates for each type. It also fits people who want the same assistant on their phone and desktop, not just in the browser. Developers needing coding tools, or writers who want a dedicated long-form editor, should look at more specialized products.

## Voilà pricing

As of October 2026 Voilà's pricing page lists a Free plan at $0 with 250 free requests, summarization and chat with webpages, and no credit card required. Premium costs $10 per month, or $8 per month on annual billing, and includes 3,000 requests a month, an automatically selected model, web access, YouTube chat and image generation. Ultimate costs $20 per month, or $16 per month on annual billing, with unlimited requests. Team and business plans start at $16 per seat per month with shared workflows and prompts, collaboration and unlimited requests. Discounts are available for some groups, so check the page for eligibility.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- The free plan is a fixed allowance of 250 requests, so it is a sampler rather than a long-term free tier
- Premium uses automatic model selection, while choosing models needs higher plans
- The extension reads page and email content, so review its privacy policy for work accounts
- Template output can feel generic unless you add your own details and tone

## Voilà vs alternatives

Sider and Monica are the main all-in-one sidebar rivals, with broader model choices and extra tools such as image editing. Merlin AI is popular for YouTube summaries and social writing. HARPA AI is better if you want automation, page monitoring and web tasks, not just writing. Compose AI focuses on autocomplete-style writing as you type. Voilà wins for people who want affordable unlimited use on Ultimate, a deep library of business prompts and the same assistant on desktop and mobile.

## Tips for getting started with Voilà

Use the free requests on your real inbox first, trying Instant Reply on a few emails to judge whether it matches your tone. Browse the expert prompt library for the two or three document types you write most and save tuned versions as your own. Install the mobile app if you often reply to email on your phone.

## Voilà FAQ

Q: Is Voilà free?
A: Yes, to try. Voilà's free plan includes 250 requests with no credit card, and paid plans start at $8 per month billed annually.

Q: What is Voilà used for?
A: Voilà is used to summarize webpages and emails, draft replies, rewrite and translate text, and create content from expert prompts in the browser, desktop and mobile apps.

Q: Does Voilà work outside the browser?
A: Yes. Besides the browser extension, Voilà offers desktop apps for Windows and Mac and mobile apps for iOS and Android.

Q: What is the best alternative to Voilà?
A: Sider is the closest all-in-one alternative, while HARPA AI is better if you need browser automation alongside writing help.

Luzia is a free AI assistant app that answers questions, helps with homework and everyday tasks, transcribes audio and creates images, built for Spanish and Portuguese speakers who want AI that feels approachable. It grew famous as an assistant you could message inside WhatsApp, which made it many people's first experience with generative AI. Its focus on warmth, simple language and local markets is what sets it apart from the big lab chat apps.

## What is Luzia used for?

People use Luzia for quick everyday help in a chat format. You type, speak or upload something, and Luzia responds in a conversational way.

- Getting help with math problems, school writing and explanations of hard concepts
- Translating text and understanding messages in another language
- Taking a photo of something and asking about it, or uploading a PDF to get answers
- Transcribing audio clips into text
- Generating images from a description
- Creating a custom AI character to chat with, such as a personal AI best friend

## Who Luzia is best for

Luzia fits students, families and everyday users in Latin America, Spain and Brazil who want a free assistant that speaks their language naturally. It is a good first AI app for people who find general-purpose chatbots intimidating. Professionals who need deep file analysis, coding environments or team features will find ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude more capable, and people looking for an assistant inside WhatsApp now need to use Luzia's own apps instead.

## Luzia pricing

As of October 2026 the Luzia website describes the core assistant as free on iOS, Android, web and desktop. An optional Luzia+ subscription adds an enhanced experience: about twice the images and longer chats, a smarter AI with an advanced reasoning mode, higher quality image generation, and exclusive premium tools. Luzia does not publish Luzia+ prices on its website; the price is shown in the app and app stores and can vary by country and billing period.

## Limitations to keep in mind

- Luzia no longer runs inside WhatsApp after Meta's 2026 policy change for general chatbots, so it requires its own app
- Luzia+ prices are not public on the website, which makes comparisons harder
- As with any AI assistant, answers for homework or health questions should be checked
- The product is tuned for Spanish and Portuguese speakers, with less focus on other markets

## Luzia vs alternatives

ChatGPT is the stronger choice for complex reasoning, long documents, coding and a wide range of tools, and also offers a free tier. Meta AI is free inside WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, so it is the easiest pick for people who want AI in their chats without another app. Google Gemini is a good fit for Android users who want deep integration with Google services. Microsoft Copilot suits Windows and Office users. Luzia wins for people who want a simple, friendly, free assistant in Spanish or Portuguese with custom characters and audio transcription.

## Tips for getting started with Luzia

Install the mobile app if you used Luzia in WhatsApp before, since that is where it now lives. Try sending a photo of a homework problem or document, which is often faster than typing. Create a custom character only if you want a companion, and keep factual questions in the main assistant chat.

## Luzia FAQ

Q: Is Luzia free?

Q: Does Luzia still work on WhatsApp?
